panels.title: Estado normal / bloqueado
panels.description: sistema/estado · lo publica el backend con el LOCK que confirma la ESP32.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT recorded_at AS time, CASE WHEN system_locked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Sistema"
FROM telemetry_readings tr
JOIN incubators i ON i.id = tr.incubator_id
WHERE i.code = '${node_code}' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) AND system_locked IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Puntaje de anomalías guardado
panels.description: anomaly_scores: cada lectura calificada por el servicio de anomalías.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.recorded_at AS time, a.score AS "Puntaje"
FROM anomaly_scores a
JOIN incubators i ON i.id = a.incubator_id
WHERE i.code = '${node_code}' AND $__timeFilter(a.recorded_at)
ORDER BY 1
